focus: The setting is a Christmas Table Runner with Holly. Match each clue to a thing, action, or description in that scene.
solvingTip: Begin with a short answer you recognize. Use its crossing letters to work toward the longer scene words.
words: Evergreen plant associated with prickly leaves and winter berries
Long narrow decorative cloth down a table center
Furniture with a flat top and legs
Small juicy fruit such as a blueberry

answerNotes.TABLE: A table provides a raised flat surface. Chairs are the separate furniture used to sit beside it.
answerNotes.GREEN: Green describes many growing leaves. It is also a color name in its own right, so read whether the clue asks for a plant or its appearance.
answerNotes.LEAF: Leaves use light to help a plant make food. The flat blade and its veins are useful details to notice when identifying a leaf.
answerNotes.CLOTH: Cloth means fabric. A cloth used for wiping is an object made from that material, not a different substance.
answerNotes.CANDLE: A candle burns fuel from its wax through a wick. Its flame produces light as the warmed wax is consumed.
answerNotes.PLATE: A plate is flatter than a bowl. Its broad surface is useful for separate portions of a meal.
answerNotes.CHRISTMAS: Christmas customs vary between households. These scenes include ordinary decorations and sharing activities as well as clearly labeled Christian stories elsewhere.

answerNotes.GARLAND: A garland is a long decorative strand. A wreath is normally a ring, so the two words describe different arrangements.
answerNotes.GREEN: Green describes many growing leaves. It is also a color name in its own right, so read whether the clue asks for a plant or its appearance.
answerNotes.RIBBON: A ribbon is a narrow fabric strip. A looped bow and a straight trailing tail are different parts of a tied ribbon decoration.
answerNotes.CHRISTMAS: Christmas customs vary between households. These scenes include ordinary decorations and sharing activities as well as clearly labeled Christian stories elsewhere.
answerNotes.NEEDLE: An evergreen needle is a slender leaf. It is a different meaning from the pointed tool used for sewing or knitting.
answerNotes.BRANCH: A branch is a woody limb extending from a tree or shrub. A twig is usually a smaller, thinner piece of that growth.
answerNotes.HANG: Hang means support something from above. A hook, cord, or branch can hold the weight while the object hangs below.

answerNotes.STAR: A star can mean a distant sun or a pointed decorative shape. Christmas ornaments represent the shape rather than an actual celestial object.
answerNotes.TOP: A toy top spins on a point. Top can also mean the highest part of an object, so the action in the clue matters.
answerNotes.TREE: Trees have woody trunks and branches. Familiar garden trees may provide fruit, flowers, or shade, sometimes all three.
answerNotes.POINT: Point names a tapered end. A sharpened pencil needs a usable point, while a worn one makes a broader mark.
answerNotes.LIGHT: Light makes things visible. A lamp produces light, while a mirror mainly reflects light arriving from elsewhere.
answerNotes.BRANCH: A branch is a woody limb extending from a tree or shrub. A twig is usually a smaller, thinner piece of that growth.

answerNotes.LOOP: A loop is a curved opening in string or ribbon. It need not be tied into a knot to have that shape.
answerNotes.TREE: Trees have woody trunks and branches. Familiar garden trees may provide fruit, flowers, or shade, sometimes all three.

answerNotes.LAMP: A lamp provides light from a fuel or electrical source. Bible lamps used oil rather than a modern bulb.
answerNotes.STREET: A street is a road through a built-up area. Its name and building numbers form part of a postal address.
answerNotes.SNOW: Snow falls as ice crystals or groups of crystals. It differs from liquid rain and the hard pellets of hail.
answerNotes.TREE: Trees have woody trunks and branches. Familiar garden trees may provide fruit, flowers, or shade, sometimes all three.
answerNotes.WINDOW: A window admits light through glass. A screen is a mesh barrier that can keep insects out when the glass is open.
